description: This Java source file is an abstract JUnit test class for testing the behavior of credentials-related services in the Eclipse Hono project, specifically focusing on credential retrieval, creation, updating, and deletion for device registry implementations.

classes.name: AbstractCredentialsServiceTest
classes.description: An abstract base class for testing credentials services in device registry implementations, providing utility methods and test cases for credential management scenarios.

methods.name: getCredentialsService
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain the credentials service under test.

methods.name: getCredentialsManagementService
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain the credentials management service under test.

methods.name: getDeviceManagementService
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain the device management service needed for device operations during tests.

methods.name: getExpectedCacheDirective
methods.description: Provides the expected cache directive for a given credentials type; defaults to no caching.

methods.name: supportsResourceVersion
methods.description: Indicates if the implementation supports resource versioning; defaults to true.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsFailsForNonExistingCredentials
methods.description: Test that retrieving non-existent credentials results in a 404 Not Found.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsSucceedsForExistingDevice
methods.description: Test that credentials can be retrieved successfully for an existing device.

methods.name: createPSKCredential
methods.description: Creates a PskCredential with given authId and psk.

methods.name: createPasswordCredential
methods.description: Creates a PasswordCredential with hashed password secret.

methods.name: createPlainPasswordCredential
methods.description: Creates a PasswordCredential with a plain password secret.

methods.name: createPasswordSecret
methods.description: Creates a PasswordSecret by encoding a password with optional bcrypt iterations.

methods.name: verifyPasswordSecret
methods.description: Verifies that a PasswordSecret matches the expected password.

methods.name: assertGetMissing
methods.description: Asserts that credentials are missing (returns 404).

methods.name: assertGetEmpty
methods.description: Asserts that credentials exist but are empty.

methods.name: assertGet
methods.description: Asserts retrieval of credentials with specific expectations for validation.

methods.name: testCreatePasswordSecret
methods.description: Test creating credentials with a hashed password secret.

methods.name: testCreatePlainPasswordSecret
methods.description: Test creating credentials with a plain password secret.

methods.name: testUpdatePasswordSecret
methods.description: Test updating an existing password secret.

methods.name: testUpdateCredentialWithWrongResourceVersionFails
methods.description: Test that updating with an incorrect resource version fails.

methods.name: testCreateAndDeletePasswordSecret
methods.description: Test creation and deletion of device credentials, including behavior upon device removal.

methods.name: testDisableCredentials
methods.description: Test fetching credentials for a device with some credentials disabled.

methods.name: setCredentials
methods.description: Utility method to set credentials for a device, returning a Future with operation result.

methods.name: assertRegistered
methods.description: Utility method to assert credentials of a specific type are registered.

methods.name: assertNotRegistered
methods.description: Utility method to assert credentials of a specific type are not registered.
